question_id_policy: Preserve AQ1-AQ4; do not silently normalize to Q1-Q4.

assumptions.mass_basis: uniform conserved reference dry loading; no absolute water mass claimed
assumptions.empirical_density: effective heat storage only, not also rho_d*(1+C)
assumptions.mass_boundary: effective Robin reference Ce, not a measured sorption equilibrium
assumptions.heat: sensible effective equation without explicit evaporation latent heat or mechanical work
assumptions.shrinkage: self-similar solid motion v=r R'/R; material xi mesh
assumptions.evidence_limit: No independent experimental validation dataset acquired

solver.method: annular finite volume + backward Euler + Picard + Thomas
solver.acceleration: Numba if necessary after S4 static coding
solver.failed_step_action: report solver_failed; do not clip or silently accept
solver.implementation_status: 代码与加密验证完成；S5正式附件和情景计算进行中
solver.implementation_note: 自定义失败状态避免静默接受未收敛时间步；未引入新材料参数。正式数值配置待S5验证确定。

validation_acceptance.details: 两档独立加密及基线与细档比较；不宣称收敛阶；异常时追加。
validation_acceptance.actual_refinement_note: N80含水率场误差未通过，追加至N1280与N2560比较，并使用dt0.25交叉验证；阈值未放宽。
